nodes.text:
@mdave1 As of March 23, 2025, no new pandemic has been declared in China per WHO or China CDC. Reports of bat coronavirus (HKU5-CoV-2) and human metapneumovirus in early 2025 haven’t escalated to pandemic levels. Focus is on health monitoring, not a current crisis.
